title: Sakra
description: Accused of murder, a martial artist goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origins and the unknown enemies out to destroy him.

title: Enter the Fat Dragon
description: A police officer investigates the mysterious death of a suspect who was in his custody during a routine transfer.

title: Big Brother
description: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet -- teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

title: Legend of the fist
description: Chen fakes his death and returns as a caped crime fighter.

title: The Swordsman
description: A swordsman who is going blind is forced to raise his sword again to save his daughter, who has been kidnapped by a slave dealer.

title: Hunt the Wicked
description: Detective Huang Mingjin faces off against criminal mastermind Wei Yunzhou in a city plagued by dark secrets. As police and criminals flood the streets, Huang must unravel the city's sinister core while engaging in a cat-and-mouse game with Wei.

title: Ip Man: The Awakening
description: After stopping a kidnapping, a young Ip Man becomes the target of a human trafficking ring and must face the group's brutal boxing champion head-on.

title: Eye for an Eye
description: A highly trained and exceptionally deadly swordsman looks for revenge after being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the assassination of an innocent woman's family.

title: Gundala
description: Gundala, who has grown up on the streets, must choose between continuing to look out for himself or doing something about the injustice that surrounds him.

title: Ip Man 2
description: Wing Chun martial arts master Ip Man moves to Hong Kong to create a school where he can teach his fighting techniques to a new generation. Instead, he's drawn into a showdown with a merciless boxer known as the Twister.

title: Ip Man 3
description: Martial-arts master Ip Man takes on a crooked developer and his gang of brutal thugs.
